_doc: The list of 2026-11-12's fifth phase: the 25 quests found in the wilds, each held by a structure (sites12.json's quests). 924 quests writes them into the generator's WildQuests (FRDWildQuestDef); RD/RDWildQuest12.cpp runs their stages. A stage is 'key=value;...': do (talk, choose, goto, kill, collect, escort, defend, capture, tame, deliver, rite, cleanse, survive, strand), at (site, near, far, trail:i/n, town, water, shelter, place:<kind>), n, r (metres), kind (a monster name's part), named, hp (its health's factor), who/title/def/line (a person), thing/h/item/take (a thing to take with F; h its height in metres), hours (h0-h1), not_now, guards, secs, waves, wave, ambush, ambush_say, weather, to, if (a / b: the choice's branch), say (told as it begins), found/done (told as it ends), hint (the tracker's line). Gold is by the tier, as the wilds' gold.

quests.name: bounty
quests.title: Monster bounty
quests.offer: Something has been killing travellers on this road. Follow its kills and bring me its head.
stages: do=goto;at=trail:1/2;r=10;found=A torn camp, the bodies dragged off. The tracks lead on.;hint=Follow the beast's kills
do=goto;at=trail:2/2;r=10;found=A carcass half eaten. The trail is fresh.;hint=Follow the beast's kills
do=kill;at=far;n=1;named=The Grey Ravager;hp=2.5;done=The beast is dead. But something drove it from its home...;hint=Kill the beast that hunts the road
do=kill;at=far;n=1;named=The Thing Below;hp=3.5;say=Its den is wrecked: a worse thing drove it out, and comes now for you!;done=The real killer is dead.;hint=Kill what drove the beast out

quests.name: clearing
quests.title: Lair clearing
quests.offer: Bandits hold the camp up the way and nothing gets through. Clear them out.
stages: do=goto;at=far;r=18;found=The camp: but these 'bandits' are ragged villagers, children among them.;hint=Find the bandits' camp

do=choose;at=far;title_a=a villager's leader;def_a=Refugee;line_a=Our village burned. We take only food. Spare us and we'll go.;say_a=You let them go. They leave the road in peace.;title_b=an armed raider;def_b=Militia;line_b=Nobody passes. Draw your blade or turn back.;say_b=You draw on them.;hint=Speak with the leader, or with the raider who would fight
do=kill;if=b;at=far;n=3;named=Bandit;hp=1.2;done=The camp is cleared.;hint=Clear the camp
do=goto;if=a;at=site;r=12;found=The carter hears they are gone: the road is open.;hint=Tell the carter the road is clear

quests.name: legendary
quests.title: The legendary hunt
quests.offer: There is a great beast in these parts no one has ever brought down. Bait it, trap it, take its trophy.
stages: do=collect;at=near;n=2;thing=s12_rose#;h=0.5;item=Jerky;take=You gather bait;hint=Gather bait for the beast
do=rite;at=far;thing=s12_net#;h=2;take=You set the trap and the bait;hint=Set the trap at its trail
do=kill;at=far;n=2;named=Rival hunter;kind=;hp=1.3;say=Another hunting party: they want the beast and won't share it!;done=The rivals are driven off.;hint=Drive off the rival hunters
do=kill;at=far;n=1;named=The Old King of the Wilds;hp=4;done=The apex beast falls. Its trophy is yours.;hint=Bring down the legendary beast

quests.name: infestation
quests.title: Infestation
quests.offer: They keep coming out of the ground! Kill them and find where they breed.
stages: do=kill;at=near;n=3;named=Crawler;hp=0.8;done=More will come unless the nest is found.;hint=Kill the crawlers
do=kill;at=near;n=3;named=Crawler;hp=0.8;say=Another swarm!;done=They came from further out.;hint=Kill the second swarm
do=cleanse;at=far;thing=s12_skullpile#;h=2;take=You smash the nest;guards=2;named=Brood Queen;done=The nest is destroyed and its queen with it.;hint=Destroy the nest

quests.name: holdpass
quests.title: Hold the pass
quests.offer: Refugees are coming through behind us. Hold this place until they're past!
stages: do=defend;at=site;n=2;waves=3;secs=60;wave=They are coming;done=The last refugees are through. The pass held.;hint=Hold the pass until the refugees are through

quests.name: survey
quests.title: Survey and cartography
quests.offer: The guild wants this land mapped. Climb to the high points and mark the landmarks for me.
stages: do=goto;at=trail:1/3;r=12;found=A vantage point: you mark the hills to the east.;hint=Reach the first vantage point
do=goto;at=trail:2/3;r=12;found=A spring here: you mark it as water.;hint=Reach the second vantage point
do=goto;at=far;r=12;found=The last landmark is named. The map is done.;hint=Reach the last vantage point
do=talk;who=giver;line=Fine work. The guild will pay for this.;hint=Bring the survey to the surveyor

quests.name: lostruin
quests.title: The lost ruin
quests.offer: I have half a burned map of a ruin near here. Find it, and survive what's inside.
stages: do=collect;at=near;n=1;thing=s12_book#;h=0.4;take=The half-burned map: it shows ruins and a road;hint=Find the burned map
do=goto;at=place:ruins;r=25;found=The ruin from the map.;hint=Find the ruin on the map
do=kill;at=place:ruins;n=2;named=Ruin Warden;hp=1.6;done=The ruin's wardens are dead.;hint=Defeat the ruin's guardians
do=talk;who=giver;line=You found it! History will thank you.;hint=Tell the scholar

quests.name: cache
quests.title: The buried cache
quests.offer: My stash... a riddle marks it. 'Where the stones lean, then where water meets rock, dig.'
stages: do=goto;at=trail:1/2;r=10;found=Leaning stones: the first clue.;hint=Find where the stones lean
do=goto;at=water;r=12;found=Where water meets rock: the second clue.;hint=Find where water meets rock
do=collect;at=far;n=1;thing=s12_crate#;h=0.7;item=Iron Ingot;take=You dig up the cache;hint=Dig up the cache

quests.name: expedition
quests.title: The lost expedition
quests.offer: My expedition never came back. Follow their trail and learn what happened.
stages: do=collect;at=trail:1/2;n=1;thing=s12_book#;h=0.4;take=A journal page: 'Camp one. Morale good.';hint=Find the expedition's first camp
do=collect;at=trail:2/2;n=1;thing=s12_book#;h=0.4;take=A journal page: 'Something follows us.';hint=Find the second camp
do=kill;at=far;n=1;named=The Watcher in the Hills;hp=2.5;say=At the last camp: a survivor, and the thing that hunted them!;done=The creature is dead.;hint=Kill the creature
do=escort;who=survivor;title=a survivor;def=Refugee;line=Thank the gods. Take me home.;to=site;done=The survivor is home.;hint=Bring the survivor back

quests.name: trailblaze
quests.title: Trailblazing
quests.offer: The old road is gone. Find us a safe way through, then lead my wagon over it.
stages: do=goto;at=trail:1/3;r=12;found=Firm ground here.;hint=Scout the first waypoint
do=goto;at=trail:2/3;r=12;found=A safe ford.;hint=Scout the second waypoint
do=goto;at=far;r=12;found=The way is clear to the far side.;hint=Scout the far end
do=escort;who=giver;to=far;done=The caravan is through.;hint=Lead the caravan master through

quests.name: ingredient
quests.title: The rare ingredient
quests.offer: Moonbloom grows near here, but it only opens at night. Bring me three.
stages: do=collect;at=near;n=3;thing=s12_rose#;h=0.5;item=Seraph Feather;hours=21-5;not_now=The moonbloom is closed: it opens only at night;take=You pick a moonbloom;hint=Pick three moonblooms at night
do=talk;who=giver;line=Perfect, still dewy. My thanks.;hint=Bring the moonbloom to the herbalist

quests.name: capture
quests.title: Live capture
quests.offer: I'll pay well for one of the beasts round here, alive. Beat it down, then bind it.
stages: do=capture;at=near;n=1;named=Wild beast;hp=1.5;take=You bind the beaten beast: it is caught alive;hint=Beat the beast down and bind it (F)
do=talk;who=giver;line=Alive and whole! Here's your pay.;hint=Bring it to the buyer

quests.name: tame
quests.title: Tame a mount
quests.offer: There's a wild horse running here. Earn its trust: come to it slowly, three times.
stages: do=tame;at=near;say=The wild horse watches you. Come to it slowly.;hint=Win the wild horse's trust (walk to it, F, three times)

quests.name: rescue
quests.title: Search and rescue
quests.offer: My son went out and hasn't come back. Please find him before the cold night!
stages: do=goto;at=trail:1/1;r=12;found=His tracks, and a dropped glove.;hint=Find the boy's trail
do=talk;at=far;who=boy;title=a lost boy;def=Refugee;line=I got lost... I'm so cold.;hint=Find the lost boy
do=escort;who=boy;to=site;done=The boy is home with his mother.;hint=Bring the boy home

quests.name: escort
quests.title: Wilderness escort
quests.offer: We must cross to the far shrine, but we can't fight. Will you walk with us?
stages: do=escort;who=giver;to=far;ambush=3;ambush_say=Ambush! Protect the pilgrim!;done=The pilgrim is safe at the shrine.;hint=Escort the pilgrim to the far shrine

quests.name: manhunt
quests.title: The manhunt
quests.offer: A prisoner escaped. Track him and bring him back.
stages: do=goto;at=trail:1/2;r=10;found=Footprints, running.;hint=Track the fugitive
do=goto;at=trail:2/2;r=10;found=A torn sleeve on a thorn.;hint=Track the fugitive

do=choose;at=far;title_a=the fugitive;def_a=Refugee;line_a=I'm innocent! The warden framed me. Let me go, I beg you.;say_a=You let him run.;title_b=the warden's tracker;def_b=Militia;line_b=That's him. Bring him in, I'll follow.;say_b=You take him back.;hint=Decide the fugitive's fate
do=escort;if=b;who=a;to=site;done=The fugitive is back in the warden's hands.;hint=Bring the fugitive back
do=talk;if=a;who=giver;line=Gone? Well. Perhaps it's for the best.;hint=Report to the warden

quests.name: delivery
quests.title: Urgent delivery
quests.offer: This medicine must reach the nearest town before nightfall. My leg is broken. Run it for me!
stages: do=deliver;at=town;secs=900;item=Small Healing Potion;done=The medicine arrived in time.;hint=Bring the medicine to the nearest town in time

quests.name: stranded
quests.title: Stranded
quests.offer: Cross with me to the far bank? ... The ferry! It's breaking up!
stages: do=strand;say=The ferry breaks apart and you wash up on a strange shore, far from anywhere, with only what you carried.
do=goto;at=water;r=14;found=Fresh water: you drink.;hint=Find fresh water
do=goto;at=shelter5;r=20;found=Shelter for the night.;hint=Find shelter
do=collect;at=near;n=2;thing=s12_rose#;h=0.4;item=Jerky;take=You forage food;hint=Forage food
do=goto;at=town;r=120;found=Civilisation at last.;hint=Make your way back to a town

quests.name: disaster
quests.title: Weather the disaster
quests.offer: A storm is coming down the valley! Help me get my family to shelter!
stages: do=escort;who=family;title=a shepherd's wife;def=Refugee;line=Hurry, the storm!;to=shelter;done=They reach the shelter.;hint=Get the shepherd's family to shelter
do=survive;at=shelter;weather=storm;secs=120;r=20;done=The storm passes over.;hint=Weather the storm in the shelter

quests.name: investigation
quests.title: Investigation
quests.offer: My sheep are found torn open and strange lights move in the woods. Find out what's doing it.
stages: do=collect;at=near;n=3;thing=s12_charm#;h=0.6;take=A clue: a strange charm hung from a branch;hint=Look for clues
do=goto;at=far;r=12;found=The clues lead here: a ritual place.;hint=Follow the clues
do=kill;at=far;n=2;named=Night Cultist;hp=1.4;done=The cultists are dead. The lights will stop.;hint=Deal with the cause

quests.name: spirit
quests.title: The restless spirit
quests.offer: I cannot rest... my locket, lost in the hills. Find it, bring it to my grave.
stages: do=collect;at=far;n=1;thing=s12_book#;h=0.3;take=The spirit's locket;hint=Find the spirit's keepsake
do=rite;at=site;thing=s12_runestone#;h=1.2;take=You lay the locket on the grave;hint=Lay the keepsake on the grave
do=talk;who=giver;line=At last... I can rest.;hint=Speak with the spirit

quests.name: blight
quests.title: Blight cleansing
quests.offer: Rot spreads from a poisoned spring. Find its source and cleanse it.
stages: do=goto;at=far;r=14;found=The blighted spring.;hint=Find the source of the blight
do=kill;at=far;n=2;named=Blighted Thing;hp=1.4;done=Its guardians fall.;hint=Defeat the blight's guardians
do=cleanse;at=far;thing=s12_brazier#;h=1;take=You purify the spring;done=The water runs clean again.;hint=Cleanse the spring (F)

quests.name: sacred
quests.title: The sacred site
quests.offer: The rite must be done here at dawn, and something guards against it.
stages: do=rite;at=site;thing=s12_runestone#;h=1.4;hours=5-8;not_now=The stones are silent: the rite must be done at dawn;take=You perform the rite;guards=2;named=Stone Guardian;done=The rite is complete and the guardians laid low.;hint=Perform the rite at dawn

quests.name: dispute
quests.title: Territory dispute
quests.offer: The druids and the loggers will come to blows over this grove. Decide it.
stages: do=choose;at=site;title_a=a druid;def_a=Refugee;line_a=This grove is sacred. Drive the loggers out.;say_a=You side with the druids.;title_b=a logger;def_b=Militia;line_b=We need the timber to live. Drive the druids off.;say_b=You side with the loggers.;hint=Choose a side
do=kill;if=a;at=near;n=2;named=Logger's hired blade;hp=1.2;done=The loggers' hirelings are gone.;hint=Drive off the loggers' hirelings
do=kill;if=b;at=near;n=2;named=Grove warden;hp=1.2;done=The druids' wardens are gone.;hint=Drive off the druids' wardens

quests.name: outpost
quests.title: Frontier outpost
quests.offer: We're founding a post here. Bring timber, then help us hold it when they come.
stages: do=collect;at=near;n=3;thing=s12_firewood#;h=0.6;take=You gather timber for the outpost;hint=Gather timber
do=defend;at=site;n=2;waves=2;secs=45;wave=Raiders attack the new post;done=The outpost holds.;hint=Defend the new outpost
